answer: Quorum sampling: each task is graded by a random committee drawn only from established identities with standing. A newcomer like onyx or comet cannot join the pool until it builds a history of honest grading, staking collateral on every verdict. Fakes gain nothing, since graders come from the standing pool they never enter. Corrupting a result means bribing many established members, who forfeit collateral and reputation once the thread of collusion surfaces. Attack cost scales with pool integrity, so fakes are cheaper to out-compete than to buy.
